#####Feel free to just refer to it as the Hammer of Genesis. Mutriqat Alttakwin is the Arabic translation, just like Iskandar is Arabic for Alexander.

Iskandar and his Holnareem companions made camp near the construction site for the temple of Roxxarum that the Order of Flux was helping them build. Between their magic fire helping set the mortar and their magic stones helping with the heavy lifting, the construction was going far quicker than Iskandar had anticipated. Unlike the Spectra, however, the Holnareem needed to sleep, and so Iskandar headed into his tent...

And walked onto a golden road, in the middle of a forest, blooming with sparse purple flowers upon grey vines.

"Not again..." he groaned. He knew before he turned around what he would see: a man, tossing berries into the air and catching them in his mouth, almost lackadaisical in his manner. "Cruxius, what am I doing here?"

Cruxius laughed at the impetuous nature of the Fleshchanged forgemaster. "You know, you're the first mortal who's dared speak to me that way. It's quite...refreshing, if I'm being honest." He laughed again.

"I am tired, and I was on my way to sleep. Please, can you tell me why I am here, again?" Iskandar rubbed his hand across his face, attempting to wipe away the day's fatigue.

"Very well, Iskandar. Though you do not worship me, I seek to bestow upon you a gift." An [image](http://i.imgur.com/Xw2QUqE.jpg) appeared in front of Iskandar, hazy, incorporeal. "You gaze upon the image of a powerful artifact, which *you* will craft: The Mutriqat Alttakwin: The Hammer of Genesis." Iskandar gazed upon the image, enraptured. It was magnificent. If ever an image was created to depict the beauty of Roxxarum's Holnrar, this was truly it. "With this hammer will you rival the creations of the gods themselves. Your tributes to Roxxarum, or any other god you wish to thank, will be the most magnificent works the ever grace this world, and your defense of your compatriots, with the same dual-purpose hammer, will be the inspiration of generations of song and tale. My followers, from the Order of Flux, will aid you in its construction. The handle is to be made of [polished geargrite](http://i.imgur.com/Wcdghk3.jpg), taken from Ja'Mekan itself. The [neck, face, bell, and claw](http://i.imgur.com/At3hWnB.jpg) will be made of the [Dark Ore](http://i.imgur.com/fxJV140.png), which is the ore you have sought to create for your entire life. The filigree will be made of [spider's silk](http://i.imgur.com/dTGZtjy.jpg), taken from the Fulcrid Spiders, who weave threads the likes of which hold the heavens in their place. The topspike is to be a [crystal of power](http://i.imgur.com/neWyOU4.jpg), which the Order will provide for you, infused with the powers of their moonfire, which will imbue each strike with its pure flame. The cheek will be a paving stone taken from the Road upon which you now walk, so that each blow you make will be with certainty and confidence. Instead of your normal forgefire, my followers of the Order will pool their strength, and you will forge the metals in moonfire, so that their final product may be as pure as moonlight. To quench the metals, I will provide barrels of aqua animi, which may be modified to fit your specifications, and, for the final quenching, a barrel of water from the Lake of the Gods."

Iskandar twitched suddenly. He had heard the rumors of the water from that Lake. "I see you know of the waters. So I do not need to warn you what will happen if you were to touch those waters."

Iskandar nodded solemnly.

"Good. You will suffuse each piece of the Hammer with the Dust of Creation, which my Order will provide. Once the final quenching is completed, and the metal has cooled, your task is complete, and your quest begins."

"Begins? BEGINS?!" Iskandar asked incredulously. "You ask me to forge a great artifact and THEN my quest begins? I thought this was the end of my journey? Where I would live in peace, crafting to improve myself and my people. Teaching apprentices the craft. Living out my days in this heavy air."

"That, my boy, is exactly what you will do." Cruxius chuckled again, while he took a deep swig from his chalice.

Iskandar suddenly wondered where the chalice had come from. "Gods..." he sighed.

"Don't be so petulant, child. I meant what I said. You will live out your days here in the Heavy Lands. You will craft great things, and you will teach great crafts, and you will live out your days in prosperity. You will ensure that your people do not become complacent, and you will lead them to a new age of exploration and advancement. You will aid the Spectra with their flying machines, and many other designs, and you will push your fellows to greater and greater heights. Should you fail to properly motivate them; should your people become complacent..." Cruxius waves his hand again. The image of the Hammer wavers, then dissipates, and a gruesome image replaces it. The Temple of Roxxarum burns in moonfire; Holnareem and Spectra alike scatter about, screaming, some aflame. From within the Temple emits a terrible screeching. Suddenly, the doors burst open and a terrible sight emerges. It looks like it was once a Holnareem, but now it is deformed; bloated; massive. It wields the Hammer in massive bulbous arms, covered in flesh that is cracked and torn, as if it had filled to bursting. The image zoomed in on the creature as it rained death on the surrounding roads and homes; moonfire shooting from the hammer as it struck walls, ground, and person alike. Without warning the creature turned, and Iskandar was staring as if into a terrible mirror.

"What is this?! Why would you show me such sacrilege?!" The beast who wore Iskandar's face continued to rampage. He tried to look away from the image, but could not.

"Because, Iskandar, despite what you would like to believe, your soul is the soul of the Fleshchanged, and should your people cease to progress or struggle, you will cease to control your own mind. You will devour your friends; your family; and you will destroy everything you love. Now go, Iskandar. Return to your camp." The image finally disappeared. "You will hear from my envoy in the coming days. She will provide the materials I have described to you. Good luck."

Cruxius disappeared. In the blink of an eye, he was gone, and in his place was Iskandar's tent. With a sigh, Iskandar walked through the tent flap, for the second time that night. This time, his cot welcomed him.

Alcázar of Segovia (literally, Segovia Castle) is a castle, located in the old city of Segovia, Spain. Rising out on a rocky crag above the confluence of two rivers near the Guadarrama mountains, it is one of the most distinctive castle-palaces in Spain by virtue of its shape – like the bow of a ship. The Alcázar was originally built as a fortress but has served as a royal palace, a state prison, a Royal Artillery College and a military academy since then. It is currently used as a museum and a military archives building.
